records.question: Gross margin by company in Q2 2026.

raw.sql: SELECT entity AS label, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN account_group = 'Revenue' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN account_group = 'Revenue' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN account_group = 'Cost of sales' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN account_group = 'Revenue' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 1) END AS value FROM ledger WHERE month BETWEEN '2026-04' AND '2026-06' GROUP BY entity ORDER BY label ASC LIMIT 100
raw.explanation: This query calculates the gross margin for each company in Q2 2026 by summing the revenue and cost of sales amounts, then computing the gross margin as specified. The results are grouped by entity and ordered alphabetically.

records.question: Gross profit for each quarter of 2025 for North Hub.

raw.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN month BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-03' THEN '2025-Q1' WHEN month BETWEEN '2025-04' AND '2025-06' THEN '2025-Q2' WHEN month BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2025-09' THEN '2025-Q3' END AS quarter, SUM(CASE WHEN account_group = 'Revenue' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN account_group = 'Cost of sales' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM ledger WHERE entity = 'North Hub' AND month BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-09' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter
raw.explanation: This query calculates the gross profit for each quarter of 2025 for North Hub by summing the revenue and cost of sales amounts, then subtracting the latter from the former. The results are grouped by quarter.

records.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN month BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-03' THEN '2025-Q1' WHEN month BETWEEN '2025-04' AND '2025-06' THEN '2025-Q2' WHEN month BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2025-09' THEN '2025-Q3' END AS quarter, SUM(CASE WHEN account_group = 'Revenue' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN account_group = 'Cost of sales' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM ledger WHERE entity = 'North Hub' AND month BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-09' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter
records.explanation: This query calculates the gross profit for each quarter of 2025 for North Hub by summing the revenue and cost of sales amounts, then subtracting the latter from the former. The results are grouped by quarter.
